A0185.title: V2X PKI Authentication System
A0185.description: Establish a vehicular public key infrastructure (PKI) to issue digital certificates for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V), vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I), and vehicle-to-network (V2N) communications, ensuring the authenticity, integrity, and non-repudiation of V2X messages, and preventing attackers from forging vehicle identities or tampering with broadcast messages to induce collisions.

references.title: ISO/SAE 21434:2021 - Road vehicles cybersecurity engineering - SAE

A0185.definition: Establish V2X public key infrastructure to ensure authenticity and integrity of V2X communications.
A0185.limitation: Once the certificate private key is extracted from the in-vehicle secure element or stolen via side-channel attacks, an attacker can impersonate a legitimate vehicle and broadcast false BSM messages to bypass authentication; compromise of the CA center or key escrow process may allow bulk issuance of malicious certificates; delays in certificate revocation list (CRL) distribution cause revoked vehicles to still be misidentified as legitimate within the window; under high-density traffic, certificate verification overhead is significant, and the conflict between privacy protection requirements and identity traceability may lead to erroneous blocking of legitimate vehicles.
